workflow: An operation receives too many arguments and enters its error-reporting path.
The diagnostic format contains a text placeholder that has no matching text argument, while a numeric count is supplied instead.
The formatter interprets the numeric count as a pointer to text and reads from that invalid address.
Diagnostic construction crashes instead of returning the intended argument-count error.
summary: Mismatched diagnostic placeholder causes invalid memory read during error reporting
decision_reason: No existing cluster has the same underlying mechanism: a malformed diagnostic format causes an argument-type mismatch and invalid pointer dereference while reporting an otherwise recoverable input error.
